- heading "[Hiring] Inside Sales Contractor @Credit Wellness, LLC" [level=1]
- paragraph: "Oct 08, 2026 - Credit Wellness, LLC is hiring a remote Inside Sales Contractor. 💸 Salary: OTE $25k - $35k. 📍Location: Worldwide."
- paragraph: About Us
- paragraph: We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.
- paragraph: During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!
- paragraph: Compensation Structure
- paragraph: This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.
- paragraph: Training Period (Weeks 1–4)
- paragraph: "We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:"
- list:
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: "Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes)."
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: "Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most."
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: "Week 0: Unpaid"
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: "Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum"
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: "Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum"
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: "Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum"
- paragraph: By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.
- paragraph: "Post Training Period:"
- list:
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: "Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually"
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: "Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually"
- paragraph: "*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets."
- paragraph: What will you be doing?
- paragraph: Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.
- paragraph: "We are looking for team members who are:"
- list:
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!
- paragraph: "You will need:"
- list:
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: Home office or a quiet place to work.
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: Strong internet connection.
  - listitem:
    - paragraph: Desktop or laptop
- paragraph: "(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)"
- paragraph: Scheduling
- paragraph: "Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST."
- paragraph: "*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training."
- paragraph: "Post Training:"
- paragraph: "We are currently seeking representatives to work on the following schedule:"
- paragraph: Monday - Friday
- paragraph: "Shift hours to be discussed with our hiring manager based on our company's needs at the time of hire. Shifts are as follows:"
